'''Coded Messages''' is a [[special]] [[condition]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion. 

It can only be put into play by an encounter at the [[Newspaper]].

==Card info==
'''Condition''': [[Investigator]]s may trade [[Clue token]]s with other investigators in the same area during the [[Movement phase]] as though Clue tokens were [[item]]s.
